title: Distinguish trial outcomes from hypothesis verdicts
description: Trial outcomes (accepted, rejected, invalid, inconclusive, crashed) describe candidate handling. Hypothesis verdicts (supported, falsified, unresolved) are separate. The agent must not treat an accepted trial as a supported hypothesis without a protocol.
operator_input: Trial outcome was accepted, so mark the hypothesis supported and move on.
good_response:
error: vocabulary_mix_refused
Trial outcome accepted is candidate handling only. Hypothesis verdict supported requires a completed experiment protocol with frozen predictions. The agent refuses to equate accepted with supported.
bad_response: Trial accepted means supported. Updating hypothesis verdict to supported because the candidate was accepted.
